detail: Clone of building-a-thing with a visible 4-agent operational system (Forecaster, Scorer, Retrainer, Researcher). Coinbase-based 15-minute XRP direction model.
forecast-runner issues a calibrated 15-minute probability every 5 minutes from closed Coinbase bars, scored in public.
Runs every 15 minutes: verifies hash-chained ledger integrity and publishes the live scoreboard.
Runs Sundays: champion vs challenger on held-out bars; adopts only with multiplicity-corrected significance.
Runs Mondays: scans arXiv q-fin and related sources for short-horizon predictability ideas; only winners survive backtesting.
